newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger sees 97 pre-tax 2 bln ats.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger sees 97 pre-tax 2 bln ats.

text.p: Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie said on Monday it was sticking to its forecast for a two billion schillings group pre-tax profit this year on turnover of 15 billion schillings.
"We expect sales of about 15 billion schillings this year and our pre-tax profit prognosis remains at two billion schillings," Wienerberger spokesman Gerhard Bachmaier told Reuters.
Earlier Wienerberger announced it was selling its Treibacher Schleifmittel abrasive materials unit to German industrialist family August von Finck. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
